patch_description: Proposed evolved ANSATZ_SPEC with a reduced per-block parameter count (10 parameters per block) by consolidating hub entanglement to CRZ gates between center and all edges (shared parameter across all four hub edges). This keeps data re-uploading structure (l=3, p=2) and the same adjacency constraints, but lowers the total parameter budget to 60 (N_PARAMS_PER_BLOCK=10, N_UPLOADS=3, N_REPEATS=2). The design aims to preserve expressive power through layered pre-RY rotations, a CZ ring, and centered hub entanglement, while improving training efficiency and generalization by reducing parameter redundancy. This mirrors the successful low-parameter designs observed in prior seeds while adhering to the problem’s fixed training loop and data pipeline.
